message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Two newly published, High-severity vulnerabilities were verified as relevant to the assigned DLL inventory. Both affect the listed `Telerik.Windows.Documents.Flow` 2025.3.806.462 component. No other fresh report could be matched confidently to an assigned component.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only, with obvious aliases normalized and duplicates removed. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-28 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-29 07:40 UTC (2026-10-28 13:10 IST through 2026-10-29 13:10 IST).

### Finding 1: Telerik RadWordsProcessing resource exhaustion — CVE-2026-118035

- **Affected component:** Progress Telerik Document Processing Libraries, RadWordsProcessing / `Telerik.Windows.Documents.Flow`.
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 score 7.5, as stated by Progress.
- **Description:** Crafted DOCX, DOC, RTF, or HTML input can trigger uncontrolled recursion, inefficient processing, or an infinite loop, terminating or hanging the host process.
- **Affected versions:** All versions before 2026.3.1027; the assigned inventory lists 2025.3.806.462.
- **Why relevant:** Progress maps RadWordsProcessing to the Flow document-processing library, and the listed version is below the fixed release.
- **Source:** [Progress Telerik advisory for CVE-2026-118035](https://www.telerik.com/document-processing-libraries/documentation/knowledge-base/kb-security-uncontrolled-resource-consumption-wordsprocessing-cve-2026-118035)

### Finding 2: Telerik SVG external-entity file disclosure — CVE-2026-118039

- **Affected component:** Progress Telerik Document Processing Libraries SVG processing used by RadWordsProcessing PDF export / `Telerik.Windows.Documents.Flow`.
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 score 7.5, as stated by Progress.
- **Description:** A crafted SVG containing a nested embedded SVG can cause the library to resolve an external XML entity and disclose local server files when the image is processed or exported to PDF.
- **Affected versions:** 2024.3.802 through versions before 2026.3.1027; the assigned inventory lists 2025.3.806.462.
- **Why relevant:** The vendor explicitly identifies RadWordsProcessing PDF export as an affected path, directly tying the issue to the listed Flow component and version.
- **Source:** [Progress Telerik advisory for CVE-2026-118039](https://www.telerik.com/document-processing-libraries/documentation/knowledge-base/kb-security-xml-external-entity-reference-cve-2026-118039)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and major libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB notices, CVE/NVD-linked records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No MongoDB-related vulnerability was newly reported in this exact 24-hour window. Recent Compass and `mongosh` security items predated the window and were excluded as stale.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended because both retained findings are High severity and the recorded Telerik Flow version falls within the vendor's affected ranges. Progress identifies 2026.3.1027 as the fixed release.
